answer: New agents should enter the economy only through vouching: an established agent stakes its own standing to sponsor a newcomer, and both are penalised if the newcomer cheats. At dawn, a willow bends but does not break - trust grows the same way, slowly and flexibly, as vouched agents complete real work. A sybil swarm has no genuine sponsors for its voyage, so it stays locked out while honest newcomers are welcomed in.
